LESSON: ENVIRONMENT

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 6
Topic 6.3: Environment

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Environment. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Identify the activities that can be carried out to keep the environment clean.
2. Appreciate the importance of cleanliness within the neighbourhood for healthy living Core-Competences to be developed: Communication and collaboration, Critical thinking and problem solving, Citizenship, Learning to learn

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Identify the activities that can be carried out to keep the environment clean.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to identify the activities that can be carried out to keep the environment clean. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. Appreciate the importance of cleanliness within the neighbourhood for healthy living Core-Competences to be developed: Communication and collaboration, Critical thinking and problem solving, Citizenship, Learning to learn
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the importance of cleanliness within the neighbourhood for healthy living Core-Competences to be developed: Communication and collaboration, Critical thinking and problem solving, Citizenship, Learning to learn. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Greet others politely using Islamic greetings you have learned.

Example 2: Keep yourself clean before prayer, just as you wash hands before eating.

Example 3: Share with a friend one good manner you practised today.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Environment.
2. Explain Environment to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Environment.
4. Show that you can: Identify the activities that can be carried out to keep the environment clean.
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Environment. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Environment important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. Identify the activities that can be carried out to keep the environment clean.
2. Appreciate the importance of cleanliness within the neighbourhood for healthy living Core-Competences to be developed: Communication and collaboration, Critical thinking and problem solving, Citizenship, Learning to learn

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
